string-array.name: news_features
string-array.item: Library: each config shows the date it was added or last updated, next to it and in its info page
Library: the list starts with the newest configs; Sort switches to names
Library: ready-made configs to download, with an info page, colored tags, search and filters by resolution, author and tags
A red ! on the Library button when the library changes, and on the i button when a new version of the clicker is out
News page and a tutorial of the config list, from the i button
Settings: the ADB bridge used by ADB actions with empty fields, a switch for ADB actions and the library address
Each config shows the resolution it was made for, set from the pencil with Resolution
Export and delete several configs at once
Dual can resume the last config, export, import and set the bridge without opening the app
Play and stop in the floating menu act on the first touch
The bridge token is hidden behind dots, the eye next to it shows it
Dual can open a config by its name and press play on it when it is already open

string-array.name: news_fixes
string-array.item: The clicker could freeze for good on a screen (pause and play did not help, only turning it off and on): the detection waited on itself while loading a condition image. Condition images are now loaded on the detection thread itself
When the emulator stops sending screen images (for example after the computer screen went to sleep), the clicker starts the screen capture again by itself instead of standing still
Tapping a config while selecting configs to export or delete selects it instead of starting it
The floating menu opens in the top right corner until you move it
Two condition images with the same hash no longer replace each other when saving or importing
A config downloaded from the Library takes the resolution written in the library; other imports no longer guess it

string-array.name: news_balance
string-array.item: Detection waits 10 ms when there is no new screen image instead of spinning, using less CPU
After an error, detection waits half a second before the next image

string-array.name: news_debug
string-array.item: An action that fails is skipped and logged, the config keeps running
An image that fails is logged and detection goes on with the next one
A whole-screen condition bigger than the screen is skipped instead of closing the app
A damaged condition image is ignored instead of closing the app
Export and import requests from Dual always answer, even when they fail
